newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia to unveil deregulation package on Monday.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia to unveil deregulation package on Monday.

text.p: Indonesia will announce a package of economic deregulation measures later on Monday, the Coordinating Minister for Economics, Finance and Supervisor of Development Saleh Afiff said.
"We will announce the package this afternoon," Afiff told reporters after meeting President Suharto.
He declined to give details of the package, but said it was aimed at tariff cuts and simplifying procedures.
State Secretary Murdiono said on Friday Suharto had agreed in principle to the deregulation package, but added that some details had to be worked out.

The Indonesian government routinely unveils measures aimed at bolstering economic growth ahead of the meeting of the Consultative Group on Indonesia, a grouping of donor nations and financial institutions led by the World Bank.
The group is to begin its two-day meeting in Tokyo on July 14. -- Jakarta newsroom (6221) 384-6364
